answer: A occupational therapist registration with case load history works as the gate: cases carried by one therapist across years. Each of 447 aliases needs its own case histories, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The spiral check runs in the open: 447 fakes pay the full price 447 times, one honest agent pays once, and the meadow trail in the ledger makes the cedar cost visible to everyone.
